FAIL_TO_PASS: missing-access: respects side effects when accessing missing namespace members
recommended: handles treeshake preset "recommended"
nested-member-access: throw an error when accessing members of null or undefined
function-getter-side-effects: respects getters created on functions
class-method-access: tracks side-effects when accessing class methods
template-literal: Tree-shake known string template literal prototype functions
original-file-name: forwards the original file name to other hooks
parameter-deep-access-mutation: tracks mutations of function parameters when accessed
known-globals: does not consider it a side-effect if a known global variable is accessed
super-class-prototype-access: correctly resolves the prototype of the super class when accessing properties
getters-on-this: handles calling getters on "this"
literal: Tree-shake known literal prototype functions
original-file-names: forwards the original file name to other hooks
propertyReadSideEffects-always: verify property accesses are retained for getters with side effects
parse-return-outside-function: supports parsing return statements outside functions via options
array-expression: Tree-shake known array prototype functions
object-deep-access-effect: throws when an nested property of an unknown object property is accessed
recursive-calls: do not fail for recursive calls
recursive-property-access: does not fail for recursive variables declarations with property access
parameter-access-mutation: tracks mutations of function parameters when accessed
